headline: Colonial Surge Sweeps Nevish Line as Mooring County Meatgrinder Intensifies
war_summary: Colonial forces have swept the contested ground across Nevish Line, dislodging Warden garrisons entirely to secure seven fortified positions alongside one neutral ruin, even as over thirty-six hundred fresh casualties and five rapid base transactions racked the sector in the past two hours. Heavy churn persists in Linn of Mercy, where five recent base events around Outwich Ranch and Rotdust left the hex divided between ten Colonial bases and a solitary contested no-man's-land. While Callahan's Passage has settled under complete Warden control following earlier bloodletting at Crumbling Post, violence has abruptly shifted into Mooring County, where opposing lines collided in the war's sharpest slaughter, consuming more than forty-seven hundred casualties in two hours near The Wind Hills. Elsewhere, frontline turnover has ground to a halt: Stlican Shelf absorbs heavy attrition without territorial change, while Weathered Expanse and Marban Hollow remain locked in tense, watchful stalemates.
